instruction: Put the red pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")
candidate = candidates[0]  # Use the first grasp candidate
grasp(candidate)
spots = free_spots("green_case", "red_pen")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=None)
# Adjust yaw so the pen's long axis aligns with the zone's long axis
delta_yaw = 1.249 - candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]
rotate_by(delta_yaw)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("red_pen", "green_case")
